headline: Wealthy customers increase, and banks' wealth management business grows
summary: Banks' wealth management business continues to grow as funds from high-balance customers increase. The trend points to rising deposits from affluent clients in Indonesia.
why: Wealth management generates fee income and deposit funding for banks. Growth in high-net-worth balances is a signal of household savings and banking-sector profitability.
